sidebar.blurOn: Blur project names and conversation titles (for screen sharing). Hover a row to read it.
sidebar.empty: Projects and conversations you use with Claude Code show up here.

conversation.tooltipOpen: Open in a tab: click to go to it
conversation.branch: Branch off into a new conversation
conversation.editorFailed: Couldn't open your editor (is VS Code installed?)
conversation.closeFirst: Close its tab first, then delete it.
conversation.deleteMessage: “{{title}}” will be deleted for good. Claude Code won't be able to continue it.

filesDialog.title: Files it changed
filesDialog.none: Claude didn't edit or create any files in this conversation.
filesDialog.footer_one: {{count}} file · click one to open it
filesDialog.footer_other: {{count}} files · click one to open it

inUse.terminals: Helm has this folder open in {{use}}. Close the terminal and Claude tabs first (they may be busy).
inUse.viewers: Helm has this folder open in {{use}}. Close them first.

rename.title: Rename {{name}}
rename.renamedWithChats_one: Renamed to {{name}}. {{count}} conversation moved with it.
rename.renamedWithChats_other: Renamed to {{name}}. {{count}} conversations moved with it.
rename.info: The folder is renamed on disk. Anything else that points to the old path (shortcuts, editor workspaces, scripts) needs updating by hand. Claude may ask to trust the folder again.
rename.infoWithChats_one: The folder is renamed on disk. Its {{count}} conversation moves with it, so you can still continue them. Anything else that points to the old path (shortcuts, editor workspaces, scripts) needs updating by hand. Claude may ask to trust the folder again.
rename.infoWithChats_other: The folder is renamed on disk. Its {{count}} conversations move with it, so you can still continue them. Anything else that points to the old path (shortcuts, editor workspaces, scripts) needs updating by hand. Claude may ask to trust the folder again.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.wholeFolder: The whole folder goes to the Recycle Bin. You can restore it from there.
delete.gitChanges_one: {{count}} file has changes that aren't committed in git. They'd only be in the Recycle Bin.
delete.gitChanges_other: {{count}} files have changes that aren't committed in git. They'd only be in the Recycle Bin.
delete.alsoChats_one: Also move its {{count}} conversation to the Recycle Bin
delete.alsoChats_other: Also move its {{count}} conversations to the Recycle Bin
delete.unchecked: If unchecked, they stay in the sidebar.

oldChats.title: Delete old conversations in {{name}}
oldChats.note: Open and pinned conversations are never included. Claude Code also deletes conversations older than 30 days by itself unless you changed that in Claude Code settings.
oldChats.done_one: {{count}} conversation moved to the Recycle Bin.
oldChats.done_other: {{count}} conversations moved to the Recycle Bin.

usage.title: Usage · {{name}}
usage.note: Counted by the files Claude changed in this folder, across all your conversations. The first look at a range can take a few seconds.

export.none: This project has no conversations to export.

projectActions.removed: {{name}} removed from the list. Its folder and conversations are untouched.

tasks.intro: Claude works in its own copy of the project on a new branch, so several tasks can run at once without touching each other. Merge the result back when it's done.
tasks.notRepo: <0>{{name}}</0> isn't a git repository. Parallel tasks need git — run <1>git init</1> and make a first commit, then try again.
tasks.placeholder: e.g. Add dark mode to settings
tasks.started: Started parallel task “{{id}}” on its own branch.
tasks.empty: Run Claude on a second task in parallel
tasks.commitFirst: Ask Claude in the task to commit its work first.

remove.dirty_one: It has {{count}} uncommitted change that will be lost.
remove.dirty_other: It has {{count}} uncommitted changes that will be lost.
remove.ahead_one: Its {{count}} unmerged commit stays on branch “{{branch}}”.
remove.ahead_other: Its {{count}} unmerged commits stay on branch “{{branch}}”.
remove.title: Delete task?

workspace.emptyState: Pick a file on the left, press <0>Ctrl+P</0> to find one, or <1>Ctrl+Shift+F</1> to search inside files.

search.hint: Finds text in every file of the project, skipping node_modules and what .gitignore lists.

remove.file: “{{name}}” will be moved to the Recycle Bin.
remove.folder: The folder “{{name}}” and everything in it will be moved to the Recycle Bin.
remove.unsavedLost: Unsaved changes in open files will be lost.

files.tooLarge: This file is too large to show here ({{size}}).
files.binary: This file can't be shown as text.
files.truncated: Showing the first 3 MB of this file.
files.conflict: This file was changed outside Helm (maybe by Claude) while you were editing it.

closeWorking.pane: Claude is still working in this pane. Closing stops it.
closeWorking.many: Claude is still working in one or more tabs. Closing stops it.
